products.code_info: All garbanzo beans product distributed from 11/15/2019 to 1/6/2020 regardless of lot numbers were recalled. These lot numbers including the following: 19318; 19324; 19326; 19330; 19345; 19350; 19350; 19357; 19364; 20006.
